postconditions.description: The minimum unit of time required to complete all tasks must be at least equal to the number of tasks N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == N + (max_count - 1) * K if max_count > 1 else N
postconditions.description: The output must correctly calculate the minimum time based on the most frequent task count and the cooldown period K.
